title: Aliens
description: Hive aliens that attack along lanes in PvE. Raid units (PvP) start from the stats of their class, with their own multipliers in a later config file. Units follow common.schema.json.

armor.description: Armor rating. Hull damage is reduced by armor / (armor + damage.armor_constant), within damage.max_reduction_bp.

shield_x100.description: Shield HP times 100. Shields take damage before the hull and regenerate (status_effects.shield_regen).

speed_mtps.description: Movement speed in thousandths of a tile per second: 0.7 tiles per second is 700.

movement.description: ground walks the lane; air follows the map's air route, which map rules keep about 40% shorter than the ground lane.

leak_lives.description: Lives lost when it reaches the Core.

type.description: Releases other aliens where it dies.
